svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: measurement of the amplifier without an input attenuator.
What to draw: the VNA with P1 and P2; the amplifier in the middle with IN connected to P1 and
OUT connected to P2; in addition the power supply of the amplifier (a power supply or a battery
drawn separately, with + in red and − in blue) going to its supply pins.
Details: the power supply clearly visible, because the amplifier does not work without it; a
warning symbol (triangle) or a MAX IN label on the VNA input connected to the amplifier output,
to remind the user to check the maximum power.
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
